name: Laozi & Zhuangzi
q: The highest good is like water.
He who stands on tiptoe cannot stand firm.
Great understanding is broad; little understanding is busy.
Deal with the difficult while it is easy.
Once you catch the fish, forget the trap.
The useless tree lives long, uncut.
The soft and supple overcome the hard and stiff.
Flow with things, let your mind roam free.
The more he gives to others, the more he has.
Man dreaming butterfly, or butterfly dreaming man?
You cannot speak of the ocean to a frog in a well
The perfect man uses his mind like a mirror
All men know the use of the useful, but few know the use of the useless
Heaven, earth, and all things are one
The greatest vessel takes the longest to complete
The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way
